evidence.quote: OpenAI and Cisco are launching Shirudo, an open-source runtime that helps teams protect Linux systems while they roll out patches.
Shirudo, an open source project built on industry-leading eBPF, helps protect running Linux systems without a reboot while teams roll out a patch.

Cisco and OpenAI have released an open-source tool called Shirudo to implement compensating controls in Linux, potentially improving security for users who can’t quickly patch newly discovered software flaws.
